services.name: Water Aerobics
services.desc: The pool will be offering a punch card for the water aerobics sessions. No need to submit a registration. Simply purchase a punch card at the pool office and come to the sessions that work best for you. All punch card sales are final. No refunds will be issued for entire or partially used cards. You must bring your punch card with you to each class in order to participate. You can purchase a punch card and start class at any time. services.name: Swimming Lessons
services.desc: The first session of free swim lessons will now be offered as a summer school class. This is different than past years. You will find those with the other summer school classes. In the event of inclement weather lessons will be canceled. Please watch for an email and check this pool homepage. Every attempt will be made to make up the lesson but there is no guarantee a lesson can be rescheduled. The Pool Manager must be contacted to set up these lessons:

services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: The ages listed with each level is to provide guidance however each swimmer is different and we encourage all swimmers to develop their skills at their own pace and comfort. Some swimmers will require more training in basic skills. Parent/Child lessons help parents learn how to help their child be comfortable and safe in and around water. This class is for children aged 6-36 months and a parent. Covers holding and support techniques, games, and how to safely help your child engage with the water.
